What if beauty standards were reversed for five years?
Piccadilly Circus, London. One minute to midnight.
Your selfie from last week: twelve likes.
Your worst photo: three million likes.
Year one: a four hundred and forty-six billion dollar industry runs backwards.
Anti-ageing cream? Now it's ageing cream.
Year two: clinics undo their own work.
Thirty-five million procedures a year, reversed.
Year three: your face on the Piccadilly Lights.
In the nineteen-twenties, a tan went from shameful to chic.
Year five. Midnight. It all flips back.
Would you finally be a ten?
